name: direct_input_balance_v6
method: Reasoning-driven weight-space programming without training or gradients
hypothesis: The measured ligand trunk contribution is roughly sixteen times the variable direct input contribution. Test approximate amplitude balance by multiplying the direct-input normalization gains by sixteen. Unlike amplifying the affine input projection, this preserves the learned offset. This is a diagnostic intervention on the proposed information bottleneck; it may damage protein or ligand geometry and is not a validated repair.
